name: Steak & Kale Caesar Salad with Creamy Parmesan Dressing

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the kale leaves and lemons.
One kale leaf at a time, cut along the sides of the tough center ribs, then pull out and discard the ribs. When all the leaves are trimmed, chop them into 2 ½-cm pieces and transfer to a large bowl.
Cut the lemons in half; juice half of them into a small bowl (that is big enough for making the dressing) and cut the other half into wedges for serving.
Finely grate ¾ cup of Parmesan.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add ½ of the grated Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing), the minced garlic, yogurt, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk together until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
3 tsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour the dressing over the kale and toss to combine. If the kale is tough, massage it with your hands to soften it.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the buns or rolls into 2-cm cubes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the bread cubes to the skillet; sprinkle with salt and toss to coat in the oil, then arrange in a single layer. Toast the bread, tossing occasionally, until the bread cubes are golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the croutons to a bowl and return the skillet to the stove.
Wipe out the skillet with a paper towel and heat over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat dry the steak with paper towels and season it generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Carefully place the steak in the skillet; flipping every 15 to 30 seconds, cook the steak for 4 to 6 minutes for medium-rare, or until desired doneness. (Use a thermometer or cut into the steak to check the doneness.) Once done, transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Slice the steak against the grain into thin strips.
To serve, arrange a bed of the kale on a plate and top with the croutons, remaining Parmesan, and steak slices. Garnish with lemon wedges for squeezing over the top.
